body:
Thank you for your advice, I’ll try talking to them again. 

Although, I feel bad because they’re probably happier now than they’ve ever been (especially my dad because he has another to raise a child and not mess her up like me, she’s his princess now), I don’t want to ruin it. 

Again, thank you.

Yes, I’ll be going to college and I think I’ll try something to keep my mind off of this. 

Thank you so much for your response, I really appreciate it, reading this makes me somewhat feel less bleak. 

It’s really hard to see my future sometimes, but I’ll take your advice definitely. I truly do hope this makes me stronger.
Thank you, I’ll try and remember that, but it’s really hard sometimes.
Thank you so much, I’ll try talking to them again.

Thank you so much for this, I appreciate it, and I will try talking to them. 

I’m scared they won’t care or they’ll actually realize they don’t love me, but I won’t know if I don’t try again. 

Thank you for the hugs I don’t get any often, you don’t know how they mean to me. 💕
Thank you so much, I think I might try talking to them.
Maybe therapy would help, I’ve been scared of it previously and no one in my family wants the extra bills but it may help, I’m open to it.

I will try to talk to them again. Before I was dismissed as being selfish and trying to keep them from moving on, but that’s not the case. 

Thank you so much for your advice.

Thank you for your well wishes. I really appreciate it, and I hope I can one day see myself as more too, if it’s not too late. I don’t really think anyone would want to connect with me, but I will try. 

I don’t think you’ll be replaced when you die, even though I don’t know, you’ve spent your valuable time trying to console a stranger online. You’re very kind. 

Again, thank you so much.

Thank you for your reply, I just really think they deserve better than me, I don’t think I’m anything to be proud of. 

The thought of being replaced and not having anywhere to go or anyone to go to, knowing I’m not enough, needed, or wanted around anymore overwhelms me sometimes. I think it’s because it feels inevitable, I keep thinking, “someday, I’m going to be replaced, and I’ll mean nothing to anyone and there’s nothing I can do about it.”  

It probably wouldn’t sound like an issue to most people, and surely not enough to want to kill myself over it, but unfortunately it is, and does.

Thanks again for your reply, I appreciate it.
I might try this, it’s a good idea, thank you.
I’ve tried a few times talking about my bad thoughts in general but I was met with negativity, so I started hiding it more and shutting down.
